notes.decision: The five-faculty enumeration: mind (ⲛⲟⲩⲥ) → Beloved of the Lights; thought (ⲙⲉⲩⲉ, restored) → Mother of Life; teaching (ⲥⲃⲱ) → [lost title]; counsel (ⲥⲁⲭⲛⲉ) → Virgin of Light/the Beloved; reflection (ⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ) → [implied closure]. The text places 'the Beloved' (ⲡⲙⲉⲣⲓⲧ) at the line-22 break — likely the entity from teaching, with the Virgin of Light from counsel.
Doubled ⳨ unclear; tentatively read as ⲛ̄†ⲉ or similar — possibly 'in this' (ⲛ̄ϯⲉ) or a corruption. Translated 'in this' modifying ⲟⲓⲛⲉⲓ 'coming.'
